svg.text: TV / MAKEUP CABINET v9 | build order | exploded reference module; mirror/repeat as stated below
BEDROOM WORKSHOP | mm | verify stock and purchased hardware before cutting | revision 2026-11-15
1. Build the recessed base from Front/Back strips. Level and support the case.
2. Fit Bottom and Top BETWEEN full-height Sides; fit the full-height Back behind them.
3. Check diagonals, then fit the shelves. Keep the plain right-side finger setback.
4. Set the hanging rail at 1650 mm above floor. Delay door fitting until anchored.
